moves.quote: But existing methods perform far from perfectly in the traffic analysis domain.
moves.why: 现有认证方法在流量分析域表现不足

moves.quote: Therefore, we propose BARS, a general robustness certification framework for DL-based traffic analysis systems based on boundary-adaptive randomized smoothing.
moves.why: 边界自适应平滑给出更紧鲁棒保证

moves.quote: Experiment results show that BARS can achieve tighter robustness guarantee than baseline methods.
moves.why: 实验显示保证强于基线，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: A critical requirement for these attacks is to attract as much user traffic to adversarial relays as possible, which is typically accomplished by means of bandwidth inflation attacks.
moves.why: 流量吸引是相关攻击的关键前提

moves.quote: This paper proposes a new inflation attack vector in Tor, referred to as MirageFlow, which enables inflation of measured bandwidth.
moves.why: MirageFlow利用资源共享伪造带宽

moves.quote: Furthermore, our theoretical analysis reveals that gaining control over half of the Tor network’s traffic can be achieved by employing just 10 dedicated servers with a cluster size of 109 relays running the MirageFlow attack, each with a bandwidth of 100MB/s.
moves.why: 十台服务器即可控制过半流量

moves.quote: In this paper, we unveil a fundamental side channel in Wi-Fi networks, specifically the observable frame size, which can be exploited by attackers to conduct TCP hijacking attacks.
moves.why: 帧大小侧信道暴露无线连接

moves.quote: By observing the size of the victim’s encrypted frames, the attacker can detect and hijack the victim’s TCP connections.
moves.why: 观察加密帧大小即可劫持连接

moves.quote: Besides, we implement our attack in 80 real-world Wi-Fi networks and successfully hijack the victim’s TCP connections in 75 (93.75%) evaluated Wi-Fi networks.
moves.why: 真实网络中成功率达到百分之九十三点七五

moves.quote: We have responsibly disclosed the vulnerability to the Wi-Fi Alliance and proposed several mitigation strategies to address this issue.
moves.why: 研究向联盟披露并提出缓解措施

moves.quote: This paper presents LogicFuzz, the first fuzzing framework designed specifically to target logic instructions in PLC firmware.
moves.why: PLC逻辑指令缺少专用模糊测试框架

moves.quote: Leveraging the SDG together with an enable-signal mechanism, LogicFuzz automatically synthesizes instruction-tailored seed programs, significantly reducing manual effort and enabling controlled, resettable fuzzing on real PLC hardware.
moves.why: 语义依赖图合成指令种子程序

moves.quote: We evaluate LogicFuzz on six production PLCs from three major vendors and uncover 19 instruction-level bugs, including four previously unknown vulnerabilities.
moves.why: 六台PLC中发现十九个指令级缺陷

moves.quote: While machine-learning–based insider threat detection (ITD) techniques have shown promising results, their effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by the lack of high-quality and realistic training data.
moves.why: 高质量真实内部数据难以获取

moves.quote: To address this challenge, we propose Chimera, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework that automatically simulates both benign and malicious insider activities and monitors comprehensive system logs across diverse enterprise environments.
moves.why: 多智能体模拟良恶意内部活动

moves.quote: Based on 15 insider attack types abstracted from real-world incidents, we deploy Chimera in three representative data-sensitive organizational scenarios and construct a new dataset, ChimeraLog, for supporting the development and evaluation of ITD methods.
moves.why: 基于十五类攻击构建ChimeraLog

moves.quote: Experiments with existing ITD methods show that detection performance on ChimeraLog is substantially lower than existing ITD datasets, indicating a more challenging and realistic benchmark.
moves.why: 基准上检测性能显著更低，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: In this work, we introduce ToolHijacker, a novel prompt injection attack targeting tool selection in no-box scenarios.
moves.why: 无盒场景下工具选择成为攻击目标

moves.quote: ToolHijacker injects a malicious tool document into the tool library to manipulate the LLM agent’s tool selection process, compelling it to consistently choose the attacker’s malicious tool for an attacker-chosen target task.
moves.why: 恶意工具文档劫持选择过程

moves.quote: Our experimental results indicate that these defenses are insufficient, highlighting the urgent need for developing new defense strategies.
moves.why: 现有防御仍然不足，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: A key reason for this lag is the difficulty in identifying security-critical patches, particularly those addressing exploitable vulnerabilities such as out-of-bounds (OOB) accesses and use-after-free (UAF) bugs.
moves.why: 安全补丁细粒度识别仍然困难

moves.quote: However, these approaches do not provide fine-grained categorization of vulnerability types, which is essential for prioritizing fixes for high-impact bugs like OOB and UAF.
moves.why: 既有分类器缺乏漏洞类型细分

moves.quote: Specifically, by leveraging cues from commit titles/messages and diffs alongside appropriate code context, we develop D UAL LM, a dual-method pipeline that integrates two approaches based on a Large Language Model (LLM) and a fine-tuned small language model.
moves.why: 双模型流水线结合补丁线索和代码上下文

moves.quote: Notably, D UAL LM successfully identified 111 of 5,140 recent Linux kernel patches as addressing OOB or UAF vulnerabilities, with 90 true positives confirmed by manual verification (many do not have clear indications in patch descriptions).
moves.why: 五千一百四十个补丁中确认九十个真阳性

moves.quote: However, their effectiveness and accessibility also render them susceptible to abuse for generating malicious content, including phishing attacks.
moves.why: LLM可被滥用于生成钓鱼内容

moves.quote: We discover that these LLMs can generate both phishing websites and emails that can convincingly imitate well-known brands and also deploy a range of evasive tactics that are used to elude detection mechanisms employed by anti-phishing systems.
moves.why: 四种商业模型生成仿冒品牌攻击

moves.quote: We evaluate the performance of the LLMs towards generating these attacks and find that they can also be utilized to create malicious prompts that, in turn, can be fed back to the model to generate phishing scams - thus massively reducing the prompt-engineering effort required by attackers to scale these threats.
moves.why: 恶意提示可反馈扩展攻击规模

moves.quote: Our model is transferable across all four commercial LLMs, attaining an average accuracy of 96% for phishing website prompts and 94% for phishing email prompts.
moves.why: 检测模型平均准确率达到百分之九十六

moves.quote: However, it is still little understood whether such poisoning attacks against the tools would be practical in real-world settings and how developers address the poisoning attacks during software development.
moves.why: 真实开发场景中的投毒影响仍不清楚

moves.quote: To understand the real-world impact of poisoning attacks on developers who rely on AI-powered coding assistants, we conducted two user studies: an online survey and an in-lab study.
moves.why: 通过问卷和实验室研究考察真实影响

moves.quote: The in-lab study results showed that developers using a poisoned ChatGPT-like tool were more prone to including insecure code than those using an IntelliCode-like tool or no tool.
moves.why: 投毒模型诱导更多不安全代码

moves.quote: Our study results highlight the need for education and improved coding practices to address new security issues introduced by AI-powered coding assistant tools.
moves.why: 研究强调教育和改进实践需求

moves.quote: Although WF attacks have shown high success rates in controlled settings, they rely on complete, unperturbed trafﬁc, making them vulnerable to real-world defense mechanisms.
moves.why: 完整无扰流量假设难以覆盖现实防御

moves.quote: In this work, we introduce C OUNT M AMBA, a robust and adaptable WF attack framework designed to address the challenges posed by real-world defenses, early-stage trafﬁc analysis, and multi-tab browsing.
moves.why: CountMamba面向防御和多标签场景设计

moves.quote: Additionally, a state-space-oriented (SSO) classiﬁer incrementally generates ﬁne-grained predictions from partial trafﬁc data, maintaining high attack accuracy while enabling early-stage and multi-tab attack capabilities.
moves.why: 状态空间分类器利用部分流量持续预测

moves.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that C OUNT M AMBA outperforms state-of-the-art WF attacks across robust, early-stage, and multi-tab scenarios, highlighting its applicability for realistic, adaptive WF analysis in Tor networks.
moves.why: 实验显示超过现有网站指纹攻击

moves.quote: While some efforts have been devoted to user surveys on LLMs in healthcare, users’ perceptions of privacy remain unexplored.
moves.why: 医疗LLM用户隐私认知仍未被研究

moves.quote: To ﬁll this gap, this paper contributes the ﬁrst user study (n=846) in China on privacy awareness and expectations in LLM-based healthcare consultations.
moves.why: 在中国开展八百四十六人用户研究

moves.quote: Our ﬁndings suggest that the prevalence of LLMs ampliﬁes health privacy risks by raising users’ curiosity and willingness to use such services, thus overshadowing privacy concerns.
moves.why: LLM普及放大健康隐私风险

moves.quote: Interestingly, a paradoxical “illusion” emerges where users’ knowledge and concerns about privacy contradict their privacy expectations, leading to greater health privacy exposure.
moves.why: 隐私知识与期望出现矛盾幻觉

moves.quote: One important research question is how to trace back to these malicious texts from a long context in leading to the attacker-desired output of the LLM.
moves.why: 长上下文中追溯恶意文本仍是核心问题

moves.quote: While signiﬁcant efforts have been made, state-of-the-art solutions still achieve a sub-optimal performance and/or incur high computation cost.
moves.why: 现有方案性能不足且计算成本高

moves.quote: In this work, we propose AttnTrace, a new context traceback method based on the attention weights produced by an LLM for a prompt.
moves.why: AttnTrace利用注意力权重回溯上下文

moves.quote: The results demonstrate that AttnTrace is more accurate and efﬁcient than existing state-of-the-art context traceback methods.
moves.why: 准确率和效率均优于现有方法

moves.quote: Detecting such vulnerabilities is challenging due to complex cross-service interactions, polyglot codebases, and diverse privileged operations and permission checks.
moves.why: 跨服务多语言权限检测十分困难

moves.quote: We present N EO, an agentic program analysis framework that combines large language models (LLMs) with classic program analysis to address these challenges.
moves.why: NEO融合LLM代理和程序分析

moves.quote: We evaluated N EO on 25 open-source microservice applications spanning 7 programming languages and 6.2 million lines of code.
moves.why: 覆盖二十五个应用和七种语言

moves.quote: N EO uncovered 24 zero-day privilege escalation vulnerabilities and achieved 81.0% precision and 85.0% recall on a groundtruth dataset.
moves.why: 发现二十四个零日权限升级漏洞

moves.quote: While signiﬁcant research, such as the TuDoor Attack, has systematically explored logic vulnerabilities in DNS response pre-processing (the back door), a fundamental and equally critical question remains unanswered: what occurs when a malformed query is Knocking on the Front Door?
moves.why: DNS前门畸形查询攻击面尚未评估

moves.quote: To address this research gap, we present QuerySynth, an LLM-guided protocol behavior exploration framework.
moves.why: QuerySynth自动探索协议行为

moves.quote: Our analysis reveals a class of severe, exploitable ﬂaws stemming from implementation inconsistencies, which we collectively term the JIGGLE Attack.
moves.why: 实现不一致形成可利用JIGGLE攻击

moves.quote: We found that the silence behavior was observed across all 44 (100%) tested services and no less than 852,770 (64.84%) open resolvers, while the anomalous echo primitives affect 18 services (40.90%) and a minimum of 75,711 (5.76%) open resolvers.
moves.why: 百分之百公共服务出现静默行为

moves.quote: These methods are limited in their ability to systematically detect P INs due to the lack of generic detection, and in providing concrete development guidance for app developers on SDK integrations due to limited visibility into the SDK integration context.
moves.why: 现有方法依赖预定义模式且缺乏上下文

moves.quote: To overcome these limitations, we introduce a new P IN detection paradigm using privacy-contextual consistency analysis, based on a key observation: P INs often manifest as inconsistencies between the privacy implications of SDK APIs and the context of their integrations, which allow for generic, P IN-independent checks.
moves.why: 隐私含义与集成上下文不一致是通用信号

moves.quote: Based on the models, we develop an automated framework, P IN F INDER, to detect P INs arising from SDK integrations in Android apps – software known for its extensive use of SDKs.
moves.why: PINFINDER结合应用分析和LLM

moves.quote: Running P IN F INDER on 4,683 real-world apps further sheds light on the prevalence and magnitude of P INs, revealing lesser-known manifestations and their underlying causes.
moves.why: 在四千六百八十三个应用中测量普遍性

moves.quote: However, the current landscape of LLM guardrails is fragmented, lacking a unified taxonomy and comprehensive evaluation framework.
moves.why: 护栏研究缺少统一分类与评估框架

moves.quote: In this Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) paper, we present the first holistic analysis of jailbreak guardrails for LLMs.
moves.why: 提出六维护栏分类体系，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: We propose a novel, multi-dimensional taxonomy that categorizes guardrails along six key dimensions, and introduce a SecurityEfficiency-Utility evaluation framework to assess their practical effectiveness.
moves.why: 引入安全效率效用评估框架

moves.quote: Through extensive analysis and experiments, we identify the strengths and limitations of existing guardrail approaches, provide insights into optimizing their defense mechanisms, and explore their universality across attack types.
moves.why: 系统分析现有护栏优缺点，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: The first major barrier to understanding this threat is the lack of benchmark datasets with profile-level sensitive attribute annotations.
moves.why: 敏感属性标注音频基准缺失

moves.quote: To address this challenge, we introduce AP2 , a well-crafted audio benchmark dataset constructed using public sources and recent TV dramas.
moves.why: 用公开来源构建AP2音频基准

moves.quote: To overcome these limitations, we propose Gifts, a hybrid framework in which an LLM guides, forensically reviews, and consolidates inferences made by an ALM.
moves.why: Gifts让LLM引导ALM进行推断

moves.quote: Extensive experiments and human evaluations of 50 participants (18-30 years) show that Gifts outperforms the MLLM-based baselines, real humans, and traditional inference methods in profiling sensitive attributes, while also being robust under various types of noise.
moves.why: 五十人评估显示优于多种基线

moves.quote: However, commonly used vulnerability detection techniques, such as fuzz testing, face increasing challenges in testing these implementations due to ineffective feedback mechanisms and insufficient protocol state-space exploration techniques.
moves.why: 协议模糊测试反馈和状态探索不足

moves.quote: This paper presents B LEEM, a packet-sequence-oriented black-box fuzzer for vulnerability detection of protocol implementations.
moves.why: BLEEM以数据包序列为核心生成输入

moves.quote: It provides an effective feedback mechanism by analyzing the system output sequence noninvasively, supports guided fuzzing by resorting to state-space tracking that encompasses all parties timely, and utilizes interactive traffic information to generate protocol-logic-aware packet sequences.
moves.why: 状态追踪和交互流量支持协议逻辑感知

moves.quote: Results show that, compared to the state-of-the-art protocol fuzzers such as Peach, B LEEM achieves substantially higher branch coverage (up to 174.93% improvement) within 24 hours.
moves.why: 二十四小时分支覆盖提高百分之一百七十四点九三

moves.quote: We show that Tor’s DNS cache is vulnerable to a timeless timing attack, allowing anyone to determine if a domain is cached or not without any false positives.
moves.why: DNS缓存暴露无假阳性的时间侧信道

moves.quote: The attack requires sending a single TLS record.
moves.why: 单个TLS记录即可发起攻击

moves.quote: This shifts DNS in Tor from an unreliable side-channel— using traditional timing attacks with network jitter—to being perfectly reliable.
moves.why: 侧信道从不可靠变为完全可靠

moves.quote: We responsibly disclosed the attack and suggested two short-term mitigations.
moves.why: 研究负责任披露攻击并提出缓解

moves.quote: In this paper, however, we demonstrate the feasibility of a protocol-agnostic approach to proxy detection, enabled by the shared characteristic of nested protocol stacks inherent to all forms of proxying and tunneling activities.
moves.why: 嵌套协议栈支持与协议无关的检测

moves.quote: We showcase the practicality of such an approach by identifying one specific fingerprint–encapsulated TLS handshakes–that results from nested protocol stacks, and building similaritybased classifiers to isolate this unique fingerprint within encrypted traffic streams.
moves.why: 用封装TLS握手构造相似度分类器

moves.quote: Assuming the role of a censor, we build a detection framework and deploy it within a mid-size ISP serving upwards of one million users.
moves.why: 在百万用户ISP部署检测框架

moves.quote: While stream multiplexing shows promise as a viable countermeasure, we caution that existing obfuscations based on multiplexing and random padding alone are inherently limited, due to their inability to reduce the size of traffic bursts or the number of round trips within a connection.
moves.why: 单靠填充和复用难以消除流量特征

moves.quote: Timely and effective vulnerability patching is essential for cybersecurity defense, for which various approaches have been proposed yet still struggle to generate valid and correct patches for real-world vulnerabilities.
moves.why: 真实漏洞补丁仍难以自动生成

moves.quote: To elicit LLMs to effectively reason about vulnerable code behaviors, which is essential for quality patch generation, we introduce vulnerability semantics reasoning and adaptive prompting on LLMs and instantiate the methodology as A PPATCH, an automated LLM-based patching system.
moves.why: 用漏洞语义推理和自适应提示补丁

moves.quote: Our evaluation of A PPATCH on 97 zero-day vulnerabilities and 20 existing vulnerabilities demonstrates its superior performance to both existing prompting methods and state-of-the-art non-LLM-based techniques (by up to 28.33% in F1 and 182.26% in recall over the best baseline).
moves.why: 九十七个零日漏洞上F1提升百分之二十八点三三

moves.quote: Existing efforts have largely focused on single-trigger attacks while ignoring the variations in different users’ responses to the same trigger, thus often resulting in undermined attack effectiveness.
moves.why: 单触发器忽略用户响应差异

moves.quote: In this work, we propose EmbedX, an effective and efficient cross-trigger backdoor attack against LLMs.
moves.why: EmbedX用连续嵌入实现跨触发器攻击

moves.quote: To ensure the stealthiness of EmbedX, we devise a latent adversarial backdoor mechanism with dual constraints in frequency and gradient domains, which effectively crafts the poisoned samples close to the target samples.
moves.why: 双域约束增强隐蔽性，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: Through extensive experiments on four popular LLMs across both classification and generation tasks, we show that EmbedX achieves the attack goal effectively, efficiently, and stealthily while also preserving model utility.
moves.why: 四个模型实验保持效用并实现攻击目标

moves.quote: Current research focuses either on maximizing automation, usually through heavy use of machine learning, or on expert systems that rely on detailed knowledge of the monitored systems.
moves.why: 自动化与专家知识之间存在落差

moves.quote: To bridge the gap between maximizing automation and leveraging expert knowledge, we introduce GeCo, a novel IIDS based on automatically derived comprehensible models of benign system behavior.
moves.why: GeCo自动挖掘可解释正常行为模型

moves.quote: GeCo leverages state-space models mined from historical process data to minimize manual effort for operators while maintaining high detection performance and generalizability across diverse industrial domains.
moves.why: 状态空间模型减少运维人工工作

moves.quote: Our evaluation against state-of-the-art IIDSs and datasets demonstrates GeCo’s superior performance while remaining comprehensible and performing on par with expert-derived rules.
moves.why: 性能优于现有系统且接近专家规则

moves.quote: While deep learning based approaches show promise for vulnerability detection, recent studies reveal critical limitations in terms of accuracy and robustness: accuracy drops by up to 45% on rigorously verified datasets, and performance degrades significantly under simple code modifications.
moves.why: 代码改动和跨函数依赖削弱检测准确性

moves.quote: This paper presents LLMxCPG, a novel framework integrating Code Property Graphs (CPG) with Large Language Models (LLM) for robust vulnerability detection.
moves.why: LLMxCPG结合代码属性图与LLM

moves.quote: Our CPG-based slice construction technique reduces code size by 67.84 to 90.93% while preserving vulnerability-relevant context.
moves.why: 切片压缩百分之六十七点八四至九十点九三

moves.quote: Empirical evaluation demonstrates LLMxCPG’s effectiveness across verified datasets, achieving 15-40% improvements in F1-score over state-of-the-art baselines.
moves.why: F1相对基线提升百分之十五至四十

moves.quote: Yet, these models are often plagued by the hallucination problem, which involves generating inaccurate objects, attributes, and relationships that do not match the visual content.
moves.why: MLLM视觉幻觉与真实内容不一致

moves.quote: We propose a novel hallucination attack against MLLMs that exploits attention sink behaviors to trigger hallucinated content with minimal image-text relevance, posing a significant threat to critical downstream applications.
moves.why: 利用注意力汇触发幻觉攻击

moves.quote: Comprehensive experiments on 6 prominent MLLMs demonstrate the efficacy of our attack in compromising black-box MLLMs even with extensive mitigating mechanisms, as well as the promising results against cutting-edge commercial APIs, such as GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5.
moves.why: 六个MLLM及商业API均受影响

moves.quote: Our code is available at https://huggingface.co/ RachelHGF/Mirage-in-the-Eyes.
moves.why: 代码公开可用，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: However, they can be bypassed through LLM jailbreaks.
moves.why: 越狱可绕过安全对齐机制，便于复现实验判断

moves.quote: Current jailbreaks often require significant manual effort, high computational costs, or result in excessive model modifications that may degrade regular utility.
moves.why: 现有攻击人工和计算成本高

moves.quote: We introduce TwinBreak, an innovative safety alignment removal method.
moves.why: TwinBreak移除安全对齐参数

moves.quote: We present the TwinPrompt dataset containing 100 such twin prompts.
moves.why: 发布包含一百组孪生提示的数据集

moves.quote: This implies that testing the receiving side of QUIC is difficult.
moves.why: QUIC接收端组合测试困难

moves.quote: We develop probes to explore how different QUIC server implementations handle the coalescence and fragmentation of payloads, covering both valid and invalid combinations of datagrams, packets, and frames.
moves.why: 探针覆盖数据报包帧的合法和非法组合

moves.quote: To address this limitation, we present QUIC-Attacker, a testing framework that allows maximum freedom on the sending side of QUIC.
moves.why: QUIC-Attacker提供发送端自由度

moves.quote: We present our results on these probes when applied to
moves.why: 展示探针在实现中的测量结果

moves.quote: This paper aims to address a significant gap in inferring precise format specifications for network protocols, particularly regarding the exact constraints on network packet fields.
moves.why: 字段语义约束推断存在显著缺口

moves.quote: To address this issue, our central insight is that large language models (LLMs) have proven effective across various tasks, and adversarial interactions among these tasks can significantly alleviate the hallucination problem.
moves.why: LLM任务对抗交互可缓解幻觉

moves.quote: By inputting the structured RFC documents of network protocols into LLMs, we generate both packet formats and reference packet parsers that iteratively refine one another to reduce hallucinations: the packet formats allow us to create a variety of network packets for parser testing, while runtime checks in the parsers help identify format errors.
moves.why: 格式和解析器通过运行时检查互相细化

moves.quote: Our evaluation of 8 protocols shows a significant increase in precision and recall, achieving a 326% improvement over the state of the art in inferring field constraints.
moves.why: 八个协议字段约束提升百分之三百二十六

moves.quote: Although boosting software development performance, large language model (LLM)-powered code generation introduces intellectual property and data security risks rooted in the fact that a service provider (cloud) observes a client’s prompts and generated code, which can be proprietary in commercial systems.
moves.why: 云端观察提示和代码造成知识产权风险

moves.quote: To mitigate this problem, we propose NOIR, the first framework to protect the client’s prompts and generated code from the cloud.
moves.why: NOIR保护客户端提示和生成代码

moves.quote: Since the cloud can use the embeddings to infer the prompt and the generated code, NOIR introduces a new mechanism to achieve indistinguishability, a local differential privacy protection at the token embedding level, in the vocabulary used in the prompts and code, and a data-independent and randomized tokenizer on the client side.
moves.why: 嵌入级差分隐私和随机分词器实现不可区分

moves.quote: Extensive analysis and results using open-source LLMs show that NOIR significantly outperforms existing baselines on benchmarks, including the Evalplus (MBPP and HumanEval, Pass@1 of 76.7 and 77.4), and BigCodeBench (Pass@1 of 38.7, only a 1.77% drop from the original LLM) under strong privacy against attacks.
moves.why: 强隐私下代码基准保持较高Pass率

moves.quote: The Attacker Moves Second: Stronger Adaptive Attacks Bypass Defenses Against LLM Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections
moves.why: 正文抽取缺少摘要和引言，仅保留标题信息

moves.quote: The Attacker Moves Second: Stronger Adaptive Attacks Bypass Defenses Against LLM Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections
moves.why: 正文抽取缺少摘要和引言，范围信息仅来自标题
